key_insight: A mixture-of-experts framework with generative diffusion models can learn secure beamforming policies that generalize across diverse wireless scenarios for physical layer security.
engineering_relevance: This enables 6G systems to deliver near-optimal secrecy performance without re-solving optimization from scratch for each new environment.
method: Select representative scenarios and train scenario-specific GDM experts for secure beamforming with artificial noise.
Use a lightweight gating network to infer the scenario from channel features and choose the most relevant experts.
Fuse the top experts’ outputs with an attention-based combiner to produce a final security strategy.
evidence_signal: Simulations show the framework can recognize scenarios, select experts effectively, and maintain near-optimal secrecy rates across a continuum of wireless scenarios.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and coverage of the representative training scenarios, so rare or highly shifted environments may still challenge generalization.
paper_title: Unlocking Cross-Scenario Physical Layer Security: A Mixture-of-Experts Framework with Generative Diffusion Models
